<@U0PRIYA001|Priya Shah> There are a few ways the platform persists tables rather than reading them through zero-copy.
• Acceleration on the data stream caches the tables at a set frequency.
• Transforms that land in the platform create materialized tables.
• Graphs materialize underlying tables for lower latency.

Happy to go into more detail if that helps.
